description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Dorgann)] and [Earth Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Dorgann)
description.text: Earth abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Earth abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Earth abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Earth Mode II (Dorgann)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Earth Mode II (Dorgann)
description.text: Earth abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for Earth abilities, grants [Damage Cap +10000 1]/[Damage Cap +10000 3] to all allies after using Earth abilities if 0-2/3+ of Galuf, Xezat and Kelger are alive

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3
